---
title: "Teacher Dashboard"
---
```{=html}
<div id="dashboard-content" style="display:none;">

  <!-- Header -->
  <div class="dashboard-header">
    <div>
      <h2>Welcome, <span id="teacher-name"></span></h2>
      <p style="color:#666;">Manage your students and classes below.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" onclick="handleLogout()">
        Log Out
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="dashboard-status" class="status-message"></div>

  <!-- Groups Section -->
  <div class="dashboard-section">
    <h3>Groups / Classes</h3>
    <div id="groups-list"></div>
    <form onsubmit="handleCreateGroup(event)" style="margin-top:1rem; display:flex; gap:0.5rem;">
      <input type="text" id="new-group-name" placeholder="New group name" style="flex:1; padding:0.4rem 0.8rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:6px;" />
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Add Group</button>
    </form>
    <div id="group-status" class="status-message"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Add Students Section -->
  <div class="dashboard-section">
    <h3>+ Add Students</h3>

    <!-- Mode A: Single Student -->
    <div class="creation-mode">
      <div class="creation-mode-header" onclick="toggleMode('single')">
        + Add a Single Student
      </div>
      <div id="mode-single" class="creation-mode-body">
        <form onsubmit="handleAddSingleStudent(event)">
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="single-username">Username</label>
            <input type="text" id="single-username" placeholder="e.g., john_doe" required />
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="single-group-select">Group</label>
            <select id="single-group-select" class="group-select">
              <option value="Default">Default</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Create Student</button>
          <div id="single-status" class="status-message"></div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Mode B: Multiple Students -->
    <div class="creation-mode">
      <div class="creation-mode-header" onclick="toggleMode('bulk')">
        + Add Multiple Students
      </div>
      <div id="mode-bulk" class="creation-mode-body">
        <form onsubmit="handleAddMultipleStudents(event)">
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="bulk-prefix">Username Prefix</label>
            <input type="text" id="bulk-prefix" placeholder='e.g., "Student"' required />
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="bulk-count">Number of Accounts</label>
            <input type="number" id="bulk-count" min="1" max="100" placeholder="e.g., 25" required />
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="bulk-group-select">Group</label>
            <select id="bulk-group-select" class="group-select">
              <option value="Default">Default</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <p style="font-size:0.85rem; color:#888;">
            Creates Student1, Student2, Student3, etc. with one shared password.
          </p>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Create Students</button>
          <div id="bulk-status" class="status-message"></div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Mode C: Import from File -->
    <div class="creation-mode">
      <div class="creation-mode-header" onclick="toggleMode('import')">
        + Import Students from File
      </div>
      <div id="mode-import" class="creation-mode-body">
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="file-upload">Upload .txt file (one username per line)</label>
          <input type="file" id="file-upload" accept=".txt" />
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="import-group-select">Group</label>
          <select id="import-group-select" class="group-select">
            <option value="Default">Default</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="handleFileUpload()">
          Upload & Preview
        </button>
        <div id="import-preview" style="display:none; margin-top:1rem;"></div>
        <div id="import-status" class="status-message"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Student List -->
  <div class="dashboard-section">
    <h3>Your Students (<span id="student-count">0</span>)</h3>
    <div id="students-list"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Danger Zone -->
  <div class="dashboard-section" style="border-color: #d32f2f;">
    <h3 style="color: #d32f2f;">Delete Class Account</h3>
    <p>Deleting your account will remove <strong>all</strong> student accounts and data permanently.</p>
    <button class="btn-danger-custom" onclick="handleDeleteTeacherAccount()">
      Delete My Account & All Students
    </button>
  </div>

</div>

<!-- Loading / auth check -->
<div id="auth-loading" style="text-align:center; padding:3rem;">
  <p>Checking authentication...</p>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<script src="js/supabase-config.js"></script>
<script src="js/utils.js"></script>
<script src="js/auth.js"></script>
<script src="js/admin.js"></script>
<script src="js/students.js"></script>
<script>
  // Toggle creation mode accordion
  function toggleMode(mode) {
    const body = document.getElementById('mode-' + mode);
    body.classList.toggle('active');
  }

  // Protect this page — teacher only
  _supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(async (event, session) => {
    if (!session) {
      window.location.href = 'login.html';
      return;
    }

    if (event === 'INITIAL_SESSION' || event === 'SIGNED_IN') {
      const { data: profile } = await _supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('role')
        .eq('id', session.user.id)
        .single();

      if (!profile || profile.role !== 'teacher') {
        document.getElementById('auth-loading').innerHTML =
          '<p style="color:#d32f2f;">Access denied. This page is for teachers only.</p>';
        return;
      }

      document.getElementById('auth-loading').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('dashboard-content').style.display = 'block';
      await loadDashboard();
    }
  });
</script>
```
